SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MESSAGE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, PARTICIPANT_ID, CONTENT, MSG_TYPE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{participantId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.PARTICIPANT_ID, P.NICKNAME, M.CONTENT, M.MSG_TYPE, M.CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = M.PARTICIPANT_ID AND P.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID -- 복합 PK 라 두 컬럼 모두 필요 WHERE M.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.PARTICIPANT_ID, P.NICKNAME, M.CONTENT, M.MSG_TYPE, M.CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = M.PARTICIPANT_ID AND P.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID -- 복합 PK 라 두 컬럼 모두 필요 WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.MESSAGE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY ) ORDER BY MESSAGE_ID
